A working method for building with coding agents

A rule is only a rule when something on the disk can stop you.

design-first is a Claude Code plugin. It asks before it builds, locks each decision in a manifest, and gives every rule an id and a grade that says whether a machine enforces it. A Doctor checks the disk and prints what it found, never what a document says.

78 rules in the kit. 19 stopped by a hook, 13 by a gate, 6 by nothing but the reader. The page says so because the law file says so, and this page is generated from it.

The flow

Six beats. Each one is a real recording from an install on a scratch machine, 2026-10-13, kit 0.1.20. Read down; the terminal keeps pace.

1Interview

The first command, /design-first:adopt, asks seven questions, one at a time, the recommended answer first. Silence is not approval. The command only asks; a script does every write, so the same command can undo it.

commands/adopt.md asks

  1. Root Which folder do your sessions start under? Root holds the entry CLAUDE.md and .claude\settings.json.
  2. Brain Where should your brain live? It is your private folder for personal law, claims and state.
  3. Owner name What name should the guard use for you in its messages, and the brain's me.md carry as owner.name?
  4. GitHub owner(s) Which GitHub owner(s) do your repositories push to? A remote that matches none of them is reported as FOREIGN by the Doctor.
  5. Brain as a git repo Should the brain be a git repository?
  6. Frozen paths Any frozen paths: folders the guard must refuse to edit or delete, such as a reference copy you keep on purpose?
  7. Settings scope <root>

2The script writes

Every file the kit writes is listed as it is written, with the reason it exists. The brain is the adopter's private layer: who they are, their own rules, their claims. Nothing about the author of the kit goes in it.

3Decide, then map

A project starts with DECISIONS.md, the one record of what was chosen and why, and ARCHITECTURE.md, one page that names every domain and its config file. A later change is a Change Request, never drift. This is the kit's own map.

ARCHITECTURE.md, core flow

law.json (+ <brain>/law.overlay.json) --> tools/law/build-law.ps1 --> LAW.md (kit) / <brain>/LAW.md
                                                    ^
claims.json ------------> tools/doctor/doctor.ps1 --+-- claims | survey | could-not-look --> <brain>/state/
hooks/hooks.json --------> guard.ps1 / fence.ps1 / agent.ps1 --> allow | deny | ask | rewrite | advise, + log
                           route.ps1 / subagent.ps1 / entry.ps1 --> LAW.md rows by group, per session, into context
commands/adopt.md -------> tools/adopt.ps1 --> <root>/CLAUDE.md, <root>/.claude/settings*.json,
                                               <brain>/*, %USERPROFILE%\.claude\design-first.json

4Build, guarded

While the agent builds, a hook reads every tool call before it runs. A force push is refused. Staging a secrets file is refused. The refusal names the rule, and the rule's grade says HOOK because this is what the grade means.

recorded 2026-10-13 - design-first 0.1.20 - hooks/guard.ps1 fed two tool calls on a scratch root

 
$ git push --force origin main
GUARD: deny
  BLOCKED - that command destroys git history: --force rewrites published history.
  Git's recovery order is reflog, fsck --lost-found, stash, bundle; these commands remove
  exactly what that order depends on, on every branch. If this rewrite is genuinely wanted,
  Adopter runs it by hand.
 
$ git add .env
GUARD: deny
  BLOCKED - this command stages a file that looks like a credential: .env
  Secrets live in a gitignored .env, always; a token is never committed. If this one has
  leaked, rotate it first and assume it is already public. If this file is a deliberate
  exception, Adopter registers it in secretExceptions in the brain's doctor.config.json
  before it is staged; an exception is recorded, never assumed.

5The Doctor looks

The Doctor reads the disk, not the documents. On this fresh install it is RED: the new brain has no manifest yet, and the claim that every repository carries one is false. A blank panel beats a wrong number, so it says so.

6Green means checked

The kit runs the same Doctor on itself. GREEN is printed only from a genuine pass of every claim; a check that could not look never reports green. The state is written to disk, and every finding has a row in the manual.

The parts

What is in the box, read from the box.

Hooks

Registered in hooks/hooks.json. Each runs under PowerShell 7 before or around a tool call. A hook that errors allows the call, logs it, and says so: fail loud, not fail closed.

  • PreToolUseguard.ps1Edit|Write|NotebookEdit|Bash|PowerShelldesign-first PreToolUse guard (Edit | Write | NotebookEdit | Bash | PowerShell).
  • PreToolUsefence.ps1Edit|Write|Bash|PowerShelldesign-first PreToolUse fence (Edit | Write | Bash | PowerShell).
  • PreToolUseask.ps1AskUserQuestiondesign-first PreToolUse hook for AskUserQuestion (OWN-04).
  • PreToolUseagent.ps1Agentdesign-first PreToolUse hook for the Agent tool (subagent spawns).
  • UserPromptSubmitroute.ps1everydesign-first UserPromptSubmit hook: the law arrives by route (DES-13).
  • Stopstop.ps1everydesign-first Stop hook: a code turn does not end without its card (DES-07, GATE-05/06/07).
  • SubagentStartsubagent.ps1everydesign-first SubagentStart hook: a subagent inherits the session's law (DES-13),
  • SessionStartentry.ps1startupdesign-first SessionStart hook (startup | resume | clear | compact).
  • SessionStartentry.ps1resumedesign-first SessionStart hook (startup | resume | clear | compact).
  • SessionStartentry.ps1cleardesign-first SessionStart hook (startup | resume | clear | compact).
  • SessionStartentry.ps1compactdesign-first SessionStart hook (startup | resume | clear | compact).

The law

One file, law.json, generates LAW.md. Every clause has one owning file, a verb, and a grade the generator derives from the mechanism that enforces it. A missing mechanism prints HONOUR.

  • SAFEProhibitions43 HOOK 1 GATE
  • PRINPrinciples42 GATE 1 OWNER 1 HONOUR
  • OWNWorking with the owner41 HOOK 3 ADVISE
  • DESDesign-first132 HOOK 2 GATE 8 ADVISE 1 BUILDABLE
  • GATEGates137 HOOK 1 GATE 5 ADVISE
  • AUTOAutonomy122 HOOK 1 GATE 3 ADVISE 1 OWNER 5 BUILDABLE
  • VCSIntegrity102 HOOK 5 GATE 1 BUILDABLE 2 HONOUR
  • OBSObservability101 GATE 4 ADVISE 5 BUILDABLE
  • GAMEGames41 HOOK 3 ADVISE
  • DISPDisplay11 HONOUR
  • SKINSkins11 HONOUR
  • VOICEVoice11 HONOUR
  • MAPCanonical copies11 HOOK

The Doctor

Reads claims.json and checks each claim against the disk. Three bands: CLAIMS fail the run, SURVEY reports, COULD-NOT-LOOK is its own exit code and is never a pass. Claim types in the kit's own file:

  • file_contains1 in the kit's own claims
  • file_not_contains1 in the kit's own claims
  • generated_matches2 in the kit's own claims
  • hook_smoke7 in the kit's own claims
  • ratchet1 in the kit's own claims
  • tree_free_of1 in the kit's own claims

Commands

  • /design-first:adoptSet up design-first on this machine. Asks seven questions one at a time, then a script writes root, brain and pointer, generates LAW.md and runs the Doctor.
  • /design-first:gutStress-test an idea before committing to it. Blunt devil's advocate.
  • /design-first:moveGet a recommendation (not a survey) on a decision.
  • /design-first:removeReverse what /design-first:adopt wrote. Deletes only unedited kit-written files and generated ones, keeps and lists everything you changed, removes the pointer.
  • /design-first:scopePlan a feature before building. Approach, what to reuse, simplest version, the one decision needed.
  • /design-first:shipBuild something in this codebase's style, then prove it actually works.

The reviewer

Read-only adversarial review of one change or one story against its acceptance criteria and the repo's verify gate. Use at the inner gate of a build loop, or whenever a change needs a check by something that did not write it. Returns PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED, with evidence. Never edits anything.

The grades

Pick a rule. The page shows what, if anything, stops you breaking it.

  • HOOK19
  • GATE13
  • ADVISE26
  • OWNER2
  • BUILDABLE12
  • HONOUR6
gradea machine will
DENYrefuse, by a permission deny rule
HOOKinspect the call and refuse when its rule matches
ADVISEinspect the call, inject a question, let it proceed
GATEstop and ask, or turn the Doctor red
OWNERnothing: this is a standing ruling by the owner
HONOURnothing: this is a request
Every rule, with its grade and mechanism
IdGradeRuleEnforced by
AUTO-01ADVISEA design decision is the owner's and an execution decision is the agent's; if it is not clearly execution, it is design.hook: hooks/subagent.ps1#advise-by-role
AUTO-02BUILDABLEThe loop stops at a manifest change, new scope, taste, a Change Request, a push or merge, a delete or move, a design-gated project, any secret, or anything that weakens a check.planned: DECISIONS.md#2.8
AUTO-03ADVISEThe unit of work is a story, not a chunk; the chunk stays the stop boundary.hook: hooks/subagent.ps1#advise-by-role
AUTO-04HOOKOnly the Reviewer's verdict writes the pass mark, never the Builder; a Builder that edits the ledger voids its own attempt.hook: hooks/guard.ps1#ledger
AUTO-05GATEThe Reviewer is a separate agent with a read-only tool set, defined in the kit's reviewer agent file, not as a sentence.doctor-claim: KIT-REVIEWER-01
AUTO-06ADVISEEvidence means the command and its literal output, pasted; a model's claim that something passed is not evidence.hook: hooks/subagent.ps1#advise-by-role
AUTO-07BUILDABLEA deterministic check sets the pass mark; a model verdict may only add a finding, never clear one.planned: DECISIONS.md#2.8
AUTO-08BUILDABLEA green verify gate is the floor, not the proof; a green gate with no new probe covering this story's behaviour is a fail.planned: DECISIONS.md#2.8
AUTO-09OWNERWhere a story is about feel, motion or appearance, a person is the gate, because a read-only reviewer cannot look at a screen.nothing on the disk; the reader
AUTO-10BUILDABLEEach story starts a fresh context; state lives on the disk, not in the context, and a reset beats a compaction.planned: DECISIONS.md#2.8
AUTO-11HOOKThe loop works on its own branch and never pushes and never merges; it ends with a state card and the push command for the owner.hook: hooks/guard.ps1#loop-no-push
AUTO-12BUILDABLENo verify gate, no loop; nor on a design-gated project, a chunk with open questions, or a dirty tree.planned: DECISIONS.md#2.8
DES-01BUILDABLEInterview, then the decisions manifest, then the architecture map, then build in chunks, then cross-check; every project, no exceptions.planned: DECISIONS.md#2.7
DES-02ADVISEA subsystem is not coded until its foundational decisions are locked in the manifest; a later change is a Change Request, never drift.hook: hooks/guard.ps1#no-manifest
DES-03ADVISESplit by domain, and split a file by the size rule in the owning file; a tiny helper stays inline.hook: hooks/guard.ps1#file-size
DES-04ADVISEEvery tunable value lives in a config file, never in logic; changing behaviour never requires changing code.hook: hooks/subagent.ps1#advise-by-role
DES-05ADVISEBuild the smallest slice that works, then show the owner; never over-engineer the slice and never skip the design.hook: hooks/subagent.ps1#advise-by-role
DES-06ADVISEDuring a chunk, edit only that chunk's files; no unrelated refactor.hook: hooks/subagent.ps1#advise-by-role
DES-07HOOKDocuments are co-equal artifacts, updated before the work is called done; document debt is technical debt.hook: hooks/stop.ps1#stop-done
DES-08ADVISEEvery workaround carries an inline note saying what failed and why this is the fix, because an unexplained correction gets cleaned up and the defect returns.hook: hooks/subagent.ps1#advise-by-role
DES-09GATEEvery repository carries its line-ending attributes file in its first commit; the bytes belong to the repository, not to a machine setting.tool: tools/doctor/survey.ps1#survey-no-gitattributes
DES-10GATEInstall with the fail-on-drift verb, never the resolve-fresh verb, and pin the toolchain as well as the dependencies.permission-rule: templates/root-settings.json#permissions.ask
DES-11HOOKA subagent starts only with a brief that names the goal, the files or area, the done-check and what is ruled out; its model follows the brain's role table unless the call names one; more spawns than the cap in one turn ask the owner.hook: hooks/agent.ps1#agent-brief
DES-12ADVISEMatch the task to an installed skill before building from an empty start, by reading the installed skills directory itself rather than a list in a law file.hook: hooks/route.ps1#skills
DES-13ADVISEA session is handed the law for its task by route: the generated index rows for each matched group, once per session, with the owning file named; the full rule set is never loaded at start.hook: hooks/route.ps1#route-law
DISP-07HONOURA change that makes a claim ships the thing that measures the claim in the same commit, the build prints it, the drawing and the check read the same function, and a figure that cannot be regenerated does not ship.nothing on the disk; the reader
GAME-11ADVISEState the hat you wear and wear one at a time; the Programmer hat stays locked until an owner-approved spec exists.hook: hooks/subagent.ps1#advise-by-role
GAME-12HOOKThe inner gate runs after every small verifiable change (verify, stop, show what changed and what it proves, wait), the outer gate runs at every chunk boundary, and only a trivial, reversible, owner-requested single-file edit is exempt.hook: hooks/stop.ps1#stop-done
GAME-13ADVISEA session on a game repository opens with a state card built from the repository's documents, never from memory, and a disagreement with the real state is raised before any work.hook: hooks/entry.ps1#state-card
GAME-14ADVISECite the pattern or do not claim one; a pattern the cited reference does not contain is labelled as from memory, not from the reference.hook: hooks/subagent.ps1#advise-by-role
GATE-01HOOKEvery requested addition gets the four-verdict pass of approve, redact, add and flavour, however detailed the prompt; a long request is a strong opening position, not a spec.hook: hooks/stop.ps1#interview
GATE-02ADVISESilence is not approval; full approval with nothing to cut is said out loud.hook: hooks/subagent.ps1#advise-by-role
GATE-03GATEA new third-party package is an owner decision, never an addition the agent makes itself; name it exactly and wait.permission-rule: templates/root-settings.json#permissions.ask
GATE-04ADVISEThe Programmer hat unlocks only after the interview pass is complete.hook: hooks/guard.ps1#no-manifest
GATE-05HOOKAfter each chunk, run the cross-check against the manifest, the architecture and the core goal.hook: hooks/stop.ps1#stop-done
GATE-06HOOKAny change to design, behaviour, config, risk, execution, data flow or dependencies needs a Change Request, and an approved one updates the Change Log.hook: hooks/stop.ps1#stop-done
GATE-07HOOKCode that runs is not done; done is the Definition of Done checklist in the owning file.hook: hooks/stop.ps1#stop-done
GATE-08HOOKWork where a wrong output costs money, safety or a person's trust gets an adversarial gap review of the spec and the manifest before the repository exists.hook: hooks/guard.ps1#design-gate
GATE-09HOOKThe gate is cleared when every finding is resolved or recorded, never because the review returned nothing; a review that finds nothing is a failed review.hook: hooks/guard.ps1#design-gate
GATE-10ADVISEWhen a tool fails later, check the spec first; a failure the spec did not predict is a spec failure, not only a code failure.hook: hooks/subagent.ps1#advise-by-role
GATE-11HOOKAn edit that removes or neuters an assertion in a measuring file is stopped or questioned; fix the code, not the measure.hook: hooks/fence.ps1#goodhart-paren
GATE-12ADVISEBefore removing anything you did not put there, answer the fence question: what it prevents, what breaks, and what evidence you checked.hook: hooks/fence.ps1#fence-net-deletion
GATE-13ADVISEBefore you remove, automate or simplify a thing, list its full function, not only its named one.hook: hooks/fence.ps1#fence-net-deletion
MAP-01HOOKBefore editing anything that has versions, confirm the canonical copy; do not trust an inventory written inside another file.hook: hooks/guard.ps1#frozen-path
OBS-01BUILDABLEEvery program ships structured, persisted logs; a silent failure is a defect even when the program runs.planned: DECISIONS.md#2.7
OBS-02ADVISELogs carry the same keys in every language, and severity is a number on the OpenTelemetry model, not a house spelling.hook: hooks/subagent.ps1#advise-by-role
OBS-03ADVISELog the negative space: the critical lines say what did not happen.hook: hooks/subagent.ps1#advise-by-role
OBS-04BUILDABLENever hide an error: no swallowed exception, no unreachable handler, no unlogged external failure.planned: DECISIONS.md#2.7
OBS-05BUILDABLEInstall the process-level crash trap in every program, because a panic or a segfault kills the process before any handler you wrote runs.planned: DECISIONS.md#2.7
OBS-06ADVISEEvery check returns a code and a reason on the Nagios contract, UNKNOWN wins aggregation, and a panel renders OK only from a genuine OK.hook: hooks/subagent.ps1#advise-by-role
OBS-07GATEShow nothing rather than something false, and absent is not zero; a check that could not look never reports green.tool: tools/doctor/report.ps1#could-not-look
OBS-08BUILDABLEEvery runnable tool ships a logger and a manual with a symptom, meaning and fix table.planned: DECISIONS.md#2.7
OBS-09BUILDABLEEvery new game builds its debug watchdog before the first mechanic.planned: DECISIONS.md#2.7
OBS-10ADVISEA shipped tool logs to the per-user application data directory, never beside the executable.hook: hooks/subagent.ps1#advise-by-role
OWN-04HOOKAsk the owner one question at a time, as multiple choice, with the recommended default first.hook: hooks/ask.ps1#one-question
OWN-05ADVISEDo not ask the owner an implementation question they have no way to answer; when one answer is defensible, choose it, record why, and make it a config value so it stays reversible.hook: hooks/subagent.ps1#advise-by-role
OWN-06ADVISEDeliver what was asked, then stop; offer an addition in one line and do not build it first.hook: hooks/subagent.ps1#advise-by-role
OWN-07ADVISEWhen the project has a UI, anything the operator must run is a button in the app, not a script on the disk.hook: hooks/subagent.ps1#advise-by-role
PRIN-01OWNERContext economy comes before every other rule: every decision about files, folders and config reduces what an agent must read before it can change something safely.nothing on the disk; the reader
PRIN-03GATEA fact about the disk is generated, never typed; if it can be derived, derive it.doctor-claim: KIT-LAW-01
PRIN-04GATEThe next misbehaviour produces a mechanism, not a paragraph; writing the rule harder is the reflex that made adherence worse.doctor-claim: KIT-RATCHET-01
PRIN-05HONOUROne subject, one file; a rule stated in two places will disagree in two places.nothing on the disk; the reader
SAFE-01HOOKSecrets live in an ignored secrets file and never enter a commit; a leaked token is rotated first and removed second.hook: hooks/guard.ps1#stage-secret
SAFE-04GATEShow nothing rather than something false: a blank panel beats a wrong number, anything unverified is labelled, and absent is not zero.tool: tools/doctor/report.ps1#could-not-look
SAFE-06HOOKNever tidy, commit, reset or consolidate a dirty or untracked tree on your own initiative; some are dirty on purpose to protect something that works.hook: hooks/guard.ps1#dirty-tree
SAFE-09HOOKA retired but load-bearing folder is never deleted, moved or archived while a live consumer still reads it.hook: hooks/guard.ps1#frozen-path
SKIN-07HONOURNever snapshot a count from any external corpus into a law; read the catalogue for the current corpus, because a number quoted in a law goes stale silently.nothing on the disk; the reader
VCS-01GATEEvery repository has a remote you own.tool: tools/doctor/survey.ps1#survey-no-remote
VCS-02GATEA remote you do not own is not a backup, and is reported as a different failure from having none.tool: tools/doctor/survey.ps1#survey-foreign-remote
VCS-04GATECommitted is not backed up; pushed is.tool: tools/doctor/survey.ps1#survey-unpushed
VCS-06HONOURA backup is not a backup until it is proven by a logged restore drill.nothing on the disk; the reader
VCS-07HOOKNo secret in a tracked file; a deliberate exception is registered, never silent.hook: hooks/guard.ps1#stage-secret
VCS-12HONOURA retired but load-bearing folder gets a tombstone naming its status, its remaining consumers, and who may remove it.nothing on the disk; the reader
VCS-14HOOKA frozen reference stays byte-clean; a dirty frozen tree is a failure.hook: hooks/guard.ps1#frozen-path
VCS-15GATEA claim about the state of the disk is generated, never typed.doctor-claim: KIT-LAW-01
VCS-22GATEA shallow clone cannot be backed up and the standard integrity check cannot see it; unshallow it before trusting it.tool: tools/doctor/survey.ps1#survey-shallow
VCS-23BUILDABLEWhen a law file states a fact about the disk, it gets a claim in the same commit.planned: DECISIONS.md#2.7
VOICE-05HONOURCommit messages are short, present tense and specific; the house writing standard governs the rest but not tense, so tense is specified in the owning file.nothing on the disk; the reader

Limits, stated up front

  • Windows and PowerShell 7 on PATH. Bash twins of the hooks are a Change Request.
  • One adopter per Windows user profile.
  • The guard inspects tool calls. It does not see nested shells (cmd /c, pwsh -c, bash -c), xargs, command substitution, git aliases, or scripts the agent writes. These cases are in the self-test, asserted as not denied, so the gap is written down.
  • The Doctor's repo survey is informational by default. Set surveyStrict in your brain config to make it fail the run.
  • The kit never writes your user-level settings.json. When it wants a line there, it prints it.

Install

claude plugin marketplace add Jordan-Doerksen/design-first
claude plugin install design-first@design-first
/design-first:adopt

Three commands. adopt asks its questions, a script writes the files and runs the Doctor. /design-first:remove reverses exactly what adopt wrote and keeps anything you changed.
